answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy deploys cryptographic attestation chains coupled with zero-knowledge proofs to verify hardware identity while preserving privacy. As identities multiply, staking fees scale superlinearly as an exponential capital exhaustion mechanism. A swarm of malicious bots cannot treat the network as a safe haven or take root on even a small knoll of influence, as spawning an ocean of clones becomes mathematically cost-prohibitive.
